intent: Add the Sprite AI remote MCP server to the user's Cursor MCP config with the provided Bearer API key, without committing the secret into the game repo.
decomposition: Keep the key out of the project .cursor/mcp.json
acceptance: User Cursor mcp.json contains mcpServers.sprite-ai with url https://www.sprite-ai.art/api/mcp and Authorization Bearer using the provided sai_sk_ key. Project .cursor/mcp.json is unchanged.
